Deviload 2.7.1 expands music imports and fixes Linux AppImage startup.

- Import public Spotify album links alongside playlists. Album names and track order are preserved; songs are matched to YouTube Music, with uncertain matches available for review. Spotify's public previews may omit tracks.
- Import YouTube Mix links, including watch links with an RD playlist. Save a snapshot of up to 100 songs as a regular playlist without matching songs that already have YouTube IDs. The guest Mix may differ from your signed-in recommendations and does not update automatically.
- Fix `Permission denied` when launching the Linux AppImage as a normal user. The internal launcher is packaged with executable permissions for all users. Checks now inspect permissions inside the finished AppImage instead of relying only on extraction.
- Update import hints and Russian and Spanish translations.

Your existing library, settings, and downloads are preserved. Windows and macOS receive the music import improvements; the launcher permission fix applies to Linux AppImage.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.7.0...v2.7.1
